models.name: vmaf_v0.6.1neg
models.purpose: Gaming-resistant VMAF, used to detect false-positive perceptual gains

notes: All four metrics are produced from a single libvmaf pass per (reference, distorted) pair.
Reference is the original raw YUV; distorted is the decoded MP4 from libx264.
MS-SSIM is reported in the [0,1] domain; the dB transform -10*log10(1-x) is applied only for plotting.
